description: Text-to-SQL evaluation set over the synthetic demand-planning DB. gold_sql is a known-correct read-only query; execution accuracy compares the generated query's result set to gold's.

cases.question: How many products are in the catalog?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products;

cases.question: What is the total revenue across all sales?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total FROM sales_history;

cases.question: Which 3 products have the highest total revenue?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(sh.revenue) AS rev FROM sales_history sh JOIN products p ON p.product_id = sh.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: What is the total revenue for each region?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(sh.revenue) AS rev FROM sales_history sh JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = sh.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id ORDER BY rev DESC;

cases.question: How many products are there in each category?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY n DESC;

cases.question: Which supplier has the longest lead time?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: What is the average supplier reliability score?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(reliability_score), 3) AS avg_reliability FROM suppliers;

cases.question: How many units were sold in total during the 2025 calendar year?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS units FROM sales_history WHERE sale_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01';

cases.question: How many product-region records are at stockout risk in the latest inventory snapshot?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM inventory WHERE snapshot_month = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) FROM inventory) AND units_on_hand <= reorder_point;

cases.question: What is the total forecasted demand across all forecasts?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(forecast_units) AS units FROM demand_forecasts;

cases.question: Which region has the highest total units sold?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(sh.units_sold) AS units FROM sales_history sh JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = sh.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: What is the average unit price for each product category?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
